caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, tan-colored ceramic crock with slightly outward-curving sides, a thick rounded lip at the top, and two loop-shaped handles on opposite sides. The front of the crock displays an embossed or incised maker’s mark reading "A.P. WHITTEMORE HAVANA N.Y." with the number "4" below it, and beneath this there is a blue illustration of a house with a chimney, surrounded by a fence. The interior of the crock is shaded darker to indicate depth. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a close-up inset of one of the crock’s handles, showing its arched, rounded shape against a plain tan background. The entire drawing is framed by a thin black border on a plain off-white background, and a handwritten signature appears near the lower left corner.
title: Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
